summary: Iteration 5 verifies BUMDES logo integration on top of iteration 4. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests PASS in test_iter5_logo.py — (a) /app/backend/logo-bumdes.png exists (921KB); (b) login works for all 3 seeded roles admin/budianto/riska; (c) /reports/dashboard, /accounts, /transactions, /users, /transaction-types all 200; (d) ALL 6 PDF endpoints (laba-rugi, neraca, arus-kas, perubahan-ekuitas, per-unit, calk) return valid PDFs > 300KB with 'KARYA RAHARJA', 'Pangandaran', 'Direktur BUMDES', 'Bendahara BUMDES' in extracted text and NO literal ''. Frontend Playwright verified: browser tab title = 'Sistem Laporan Keuangan | BUMDES Karya Raharja'; favicon link[rel=icon] points to /logo-bumdes.webp; Login page renders (no more phosphor duotone icons); after admin login sidebar shows ; dashboard greeting = 'Admin Utama, ini ringkasan tahun ini.'; navigation to /transactions, /accounts, /users works; mobile viewport (390x844) top-bar renders small logo (visible, naturalWidth=2000). Note: initial fetch showed stale index.html served without and old description — required `supervisorctl restart frontend` to pick up index.html changes (CRA caches template in memory); after restart, favicon+description reflect the new values.

issues: Logo image renders correctly with rounded-full mask and 3px white border ring. No contrast/spacing issues observed.

critical_code_review_comments: index.html changes (favicon, description, title) require frontend supervisor restart to take effect because CRA dev server caches the HTML template — worth documenting for future iterations so agents don't chase phantom favicon-missing bugs.

Backend embeds a 900KB 2000x2000 PNG logo on every PDF page (only used in _pdf_header once, so ReportLab does compress it — final PDFs still ~500-800KB which is acceptable but could be halved by shipping a 512x512 PNG instead).
server.py now ~1189 lines — still recommend splitting PDF module into pdf_reports.py (unchanged suggestion from iter4).
Consider adding <link rel='apple-touch-icon' href='/logo-bumdes.webp' /> for better mobile home-screen support (nice-to-have).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_logo.py (new — 15 tests covering logo asset, login/list endpoints non-regression, and all 6 PDFs with size>300KB + text extraction)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login logo, sidebar logo, favicon, title, mobile top-bar, dashboard greeting, nav routes all verified)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Uses existing DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 = logo-only change; all iter4 features remain functional. If main agent modifies /app/frontend/public/index.html (title/favicon/meta) again, remember to `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` and wait ~10s for CRA to re-serve the new template — hot reload alone does NOT pick up index.html changes. PDF logo path is /app/backend/logo-bumdes.png loaded via _LOGO_PATH constant; if missing, _pdf_header falls back to text-only header (no exception raised).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs. One environmental gotcha discovered: CRA dev server serves cached index.html; supervisorctl restart frontend required to publish new favicon/title. Documented for next agent.
